verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing/entitlement/metering layer built on top of Stripe (confirmed by autumn-comm-4, which notes it lacks support for other payment providers like Paystack), but the evidence pack contains no mention of Autumn configuring or exposing digital wallets, local payment methods, bank redirects, or BNPL options in checkout. Missing for 10: any documentation of wallet/BNPL/local payment method support, checkout configuration options, or evidence Autumn surfaces Stripe's payment-method capabilities to founders.
